methods.name: ACF, PACF, CCF, Box, PP and spectrum: the missing-value refusal names the column and the count R reports (RF-34)
methods.reference: stats::acf / pacf / ccf / spectrum / spec.ar refuse NA (na.action = na.fail); the count is sum(is.na(x)). Box.test (na.pass) and PP.test (NA statistic) do not refuse; p2a refuses with the same count
quantities: number of missing values in the refusal of each reader (x, xi, yi)

methods.name: Missing cells and integer columns through MCP and the CLI (X-2, X-8 reviewer data)
quantities: t and df (one-sample, paired, Welch) with empty cells, and the rows used
cor.test r, t, df, p and pairs used
one-way ANOVA F, p, df, SS and rows used
t, ANOVA, Wilcoxon V and exact p, cor.test on Int64 columns
Kaplan-Meier S(t), SE, numbers at risk and events, and median with Int64 time and status
methods.tolerance: MCP text at print precision (t 6 decimals, df 2, ANOVA 4, KM median 3); JSON values at validation/README.md n < 100 (means 1e-6, statistics and SEs 1e-5 relative, p-values 1e-5 relative or 1e-12 absolute); df and counts exact

methods.name: CLI causal iv, mediation and staggered-did report dropped rows
methods.reference: AER::ivreg with the HC1 (sandwich) Wald F of the excluded instruments; stats::complete.cases and the Hajek IPW units kept with p2a's trimming rule (0.05); did 2.1's att_gt formulas (est_method 'reg', bstrap = FALSE) as implemented in validation/r/cases/causal_did.R; on the complete rows (the T2-WP08, WP13 and WP12 cases)
quantities: rows used and dropped, missing cells per column (note and JSON missing)
first-stage HC1 Wald F of the excluded instruments and its df
pre-trend Wald statistic, df and p (pretrend_test, with its method)
methods.tolerance: counts exact; F and the Wald statistic 1e-5 relative, p 1e-5 relative or 1e-12 absolute (validation/README.md, n = 294 and 720)
